description: Where the model's input values came from: each source cites a spot in a project file or a web page, for one value in one scenario. Narrow by component, type, attribute or file; scenario shows the sources backing what that scenario uses. Warnings say when the value or the file has changed since the source was added. unsourced: true instead lists the values set with no source, and how many are sourced by type.

scenario.description: Scenario name. Absent or "base": the base network, whose source also backs a scenario that keeps the base value.

name: get_sources
